INVESTIGATIONS OF CARCINOMA OF THE PROSTATE
Investigation
- FBC and ESR
- Serum , electrolytes, urea and creatinine
- Transrectal ultrasound
- Abdominal ultrasound
- Prostate biopsy
- X-ray- Lumbosacral spine, chest
- MRI/CT scan
- Radionuclide bone scan
